apps.name: Fluxa
apps.subtitle: Your media, in one place.
apps.versionDescription:
## What's Changed

- fix(desktop): center the window on its monitor at launch (`d4e81e9a`)
- feat(calendar): show upcoming episodes for Nuvio profiles (`95ecd2df`)
- fix(tv): keep continue-watching artwork cached across focus scale (`702dfdd5`)
- feat(addons): rename add-ons from an edit modal (`3e0e4c03`)
- fix(plugins): support binary fetch bodies and stop reading oversized responses (`00215b29`)
- fix(plugins): close runtime gaps with Node (timers, async fetch, Buffer, URLSearchParams, console, hop-by-hop headers) (`42fe78b3`)
- fix(plugins): stop injecting browser navigation headers into plugin requests (`95fab92f`)
- fix(player): keep the focus ring above the sources modal and scroll chips to focus (`1b3853fa`)
- fix(plugins): send script fetch metadata instead of navigation headers (`a3f1dea5`)
- fix(android): survive the Cloudflare WebView render process being killed (`e37d2461`)
- fix(android): rebuild the Rust libraries when core changes (`48eb75ae`)
- fix(plugins): run six plugin workers on Android (`3ab6373f`)
- fix(plugins): run scraper jobs concurrently on each worker (`ca0efb49`)
- perf(player): cache the episode list per session (`1fb644b8`)
- perf(player): cache the episode list and pending addons instead of recomputing every frame (`512adaaf`)
- perf(player): share the source rows instead of cloning them every frame (`ce372bdc`)
- fix(torrent): pick the file by the addon filename hint before the file index (`45405ca8`)
- fix(player): cut the embedded subtitle
